subject: NimbleWorks red-team: findings and IR evidence request
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@nimbleworks.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: redteam@nimbleworks.io
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: NimbleWorks red-team findings + evidence request

Hannah —

Thanks again for the access window last week. Our red-team completed the engagement and we have a short list of findings that need triage. Attached is a summary report (nimbleworks_findings_summary.pdf). Two of the findings look like possible memory-exposure vectors that would require a short forensic export to validate impact.

Per NimbleWorks process, we need the following from you within 48 hours to close the loop on the advisory:
- Confirmation of receipt of the findings
- A copy of your current Incident Response Plan (IRP) or the IRP section that covers external pen-tests (PDF or link)
- A small forensic package (stack traces, relevant logs, and any related S3 object metadata) for the two flagged endpoints (encrypted)

We recognize this is sensitive; we can accept an encrypted tarball and will provide a public key if needed. Let us know the best point of contact and preferred transfer mechanism.

Attachment: nimbleworks_findings_summary.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

— Alicia Gomez
Director, Security Assessments
NimbleWorks
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@nimbleworks.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: NimbleWorks red-team findings + evidence request

Alicia —

Receipt confirmed, thank you for the report. Forwarding to our security ops and engineering leads to assemble the package. High level plan:

- Vanessa will coordinate the IRP snapshot and any SOC 2/CAIQ crosswalk sections that are relevant.
- Ben will own the forensic export and will provision an encrypted bundle for transfer.

Can you confirm: do you require the export in a specific format (tar.gz vs zip) and do you have a preferred S3 presigned URL or public-key for encryption? We can turn around the IRP extract within business hours and target the forensic bundle within ~36 hours.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 12:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: NimbleWorks red-team findings + evidence request

Hannah / Vanessa —

Quick status update and plan for the export:

- Format: we will produce a tar.gz encrypted with your PGP key or the public key Alicia provides. Tarball will contain: selected syslog slices, application request traces, kernel oops stacks (anonymized where irrelevant), and S3 object metadata for the affected buckets.
- Timeline: prep + approval from legal will take ~6 hours; collection and redaction ~8 hours; packaging + upload ~2 hours. Targeting delivery by 2026-12-19 17:00 PST.
- Attachments: IRP copy (IRP_v3.pdf) and a small sample for review. Full forensic export will be uploaded to a presigned S3 link and we will email integrity checksums.

I have started the data pull; legal flagged one telemetry record that includes user-identifiable metadata — I will remove PII before packaging. If NimbleWorks requires retained logs in original parity, we need a signed NDA addendum; otherwise sanitized artifacts should be sufficient for validation.

Attachment preview: IRP_v3.pdf (PDF, 95KB)

— Ben
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@nimbleworks.io>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: NimbleWorks red-team findings + evidence request

Alicia —

Attached is the IRP snapshot you requested (IRP_v3.pdf) and we've uploaded the forensic bundle to the presigned link below. The bundle is encrypted with the public key you provided and includes checksums. We redacted user identifiers per our legal guidance; if NimbleWorks needs the unredacted copy under a narrow NDA, please route the request through your procurement/legal contact and we'll expedite.

Presigned URL (expires 2026-12-23): https://s3.redwood.com/presigned/forensics-nw-20261219.tar.gz
Checksums: SHA256: 3b2f1e... (sent over separate channel)

Attachments: forensics_export_20261219.tar.gz (encrypted archive, 48MB)

Next steps we propose:
- NimbleWorks to confirm that the sanitized artifacts are sufficient to validate the two flagged findings.
- If NimbleWorks requests follow-up testing or a retest window, we can schedule a 2-hour sync during Jan 2027.
- Redwood will record this as an IR event and add a postmortem doc to SEC-432.

Thanks for the collaboration — please confirm receipt when you can.

Best,
Hannah
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
